verification_guards.cases: Dirty production source, proof template, annotation and toolchain pin edits; incorrect issue, PR and supplemental source links; unknown PR states; unchanged dirty inputs and proof/cleanup failure retention.
verification_guards.limits: These are runner and catalog integrity regressions. A prover double isolates runner state handling; the real Verus contracts and negative controls are qualified separately in Linux CI.

endpoint_preflight.limits: The exact production preflight block was compiled with a table of canonical network names. Name/ID resolution, live attachments and creation side effects require the shared tests/api-compatibility.py fixture on reference Docker and disposable Asagiri.

xattr_scratch_paths.method: The same checked-in integration test compiled in a standalone Cargo harness on native macOS ARM64, with relative and absolute ASAGIRI_XATTR_TEST_DIR values. Full workspace/platform qualification remains separate.

qualification: Follow-up source and local evidence. Combined platform and live qualification is still required before main integration and release.
